title: MOF contribution-credential prototype for AI-ready MOF data
description: Synthetic, non-financial and non-ranking provenance demonstration that restores evidence-linked generic and MOF research-object semantics and integrates them with deterministic scoring, real nbclient notebook execution, and clean-output validation.
notes: This version restores the semantic/schema layer while retaining the hardened v0.3.4-alpha execution baseline. The related identifier points only to the historical v0.3.4-alpha release as the previous version; no v0.3.5-alpha DOI or publication date is predeclared.
